research_notes: For future 16m+ probes, the evidence cadence can be reduced to richer batches while still proving continued work across time.
A cadence target such as one durable batch per bounded unit group is preferable to one write per trivial micro-step.
The current sample's dense cadence intentionally stress-tests I/O/checkpoint behavior.
If dense I/O lowers the observed boundary, that may be operationally relevant because real relay work also checkpoints.
Cross-profile replication will determine whether the boundary is specific to this write-heavy mixed profile.
The universal cap should respect the worst representative profile rather than averaging it away.
